response.sql: WITH race_avg_wins AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) as race_avg_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_avg_wins AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_wins) as country_avg_wins FROM race_avg_wins GROUP BY country), overall_avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as overall_avg FROM country_avg_wins), above_overall AS (SELECT caw.country, caw.country_avg_wins, oac.overall_avg FROM country_avg_wins caw CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oac WHERE caw.country_avg_wins > oac.overall_avg), group_avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as group_avg FROM above_overall), final_results AS (SELECT ao.country, ao.country_avg_wins, ao.overall_avg, gac.group_avg, (ao.country_avg_wins - ao.overall_avg) as above_overall_diff, (ao.country_avg_wins - gac.group_avg) as above_group_diff FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN group_avg_calc gac WHERE ao.country_avg_wins > gac.group_avg) SELECT country, country_avg_wins as average_wins, above_overall_diff as above_overall_avg, above_group_diff as above_group_avg FROM final_results ORDER BY country_avg_wins DESC
